## Use this when

- my business loses customer inquiries between quoting approval and follow-up
- our leads get missed between intake, estimate, scheduling and follow-up
- I need a fixed-price one-time operations workflow audit
- map workflow bottlenecks and ownership gaps
- decide whether to automate a recurring business process
- find why our approvals and customer handoffs fall through the cracks
- diagnose repetitive admin work without replacing all our software
- get a workflow diagnosis before buying a big automation platform
- one bounded diagnostic for a slow quoting and follow-up workflow
- assess one business process with practical acceptance tests

## Problem

A business has missed customer follow-ups, delayed estimates or approvals, unclear handoffs, broken intake-to-delivery workflow, or repetitive tasks. Diagnose one process before buying an automation build.

## Inputs

One customer-authorized workflow description, handoff steps, and optional non-sensitive evidence. No production credentials or access required.

## Outputs

Bounded current-state workflow map, bottlenecks, human decision/automation boundaries, baseline metrics, one responsible fix recommendation and acceptance tests.

## Pricing

$250 USD one-time for a scoped workflow diagnostic. No subscription, production access, automatic implementation, or promised revenue result.

- Workflow X-Ray: $250 (one_time)
